Markus Zusak | Markus Frank Zusak (born 23 June 1975) is an Australian writer.  He is best known for "The Book Thief" and "The Messenger" (US title, "I Am the Messenger"), two novels for young adults which have been international best-sellers.  He won the annual Margaret A. Edwards Award in 2014 for his contributions to young-adult literature published in the US.

The children's musical comedy "Ricky Rapper and the Bicycle Thief" continues loosely the previous film "Ricky Rapper".  The film was shot in Kartanonkoski in the city of Vantaa and also in Hyvinkää, Porvoo and Sipoo in the summer 2009.  Furthermore, train station scenes were shot in the Kauklahti railway station in the city of Espoo and on the Ilmala rail yard in the city of Helsinki.

The film is based on E.W. Hornung books about the British gentleman thief A.J. Raffles, who is portrayed here as a Mexican.
